title: Telemetry: tool, model and operation measurements with intervals, and advice-only routing (#1382)
body:
Fixes #1382.

- **`telemetry.js`** (new) builds one versioned view from measurements Mana already makes:
  - **Tool-call log:** each call now also records its task outcome (succeeded, returned, task-failed, denied, pending, threw) and the active model.
  - **Bench and behaviour-eval reports:** from `bench/results/*/report.json`.
  - **Operation timings:** this process's `perfMetrics`.
- **Per tool and model:** samples, outcomes, transport failures vs task failures (with a 95% interval), p50/p95 latency, and a stale flag. A returned string counts as "returned", not as success.
- **Per kind, model and context:** the newest pass rate with its interval. A config change gets its own row.
- **Missing vs zero:** missing measurements are listed under `missing`, never shown as zero. User corrections aren't recorded anywhere yet, so they're listed there.
- **`recommendRoute`** is advice only. It needs at least 10 fresh runs, and only recommends a model whose whole interval beats the current one's estimate. It respects local-only mode and never picks a cloud model that isn't an approved fallback. Nothing changes a setting, a model or an approval.
- **`GET /telemetry`** (admin-key protected) returns the summary, recommendations and short planner lines for #1383. The route passes no approved fallbacks, so it never recommends a cloud model.
- **Bounded:** the tool-call log is capped at 4 MB (keeps the newest half). Telemetry reads the last 30 days, at most 5000 calls and the newest 50 reports. Args stay redacted as before.

Tests: `test/telemetry.test.js`, run in CI.
interface: The merged change for PR #1393 is covered by test/telemetry.test.js.
why: Additional real merged-fix benchmark case selected to broaden the agentic coding evaluation.
